templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.description: Token 'key' sendirian dianggap sensitif oleh regex /^(?:api|...)?key$/i karena non-capturing group opsional, memicu false positive pada kunci biasa.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.impact: False Positive pada idiom kode umum seperti `const key = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123';`
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.resolution: Fixed in commit 5ed3666 (Task F-D). Key name tokenized by delimiters, camelCase/PascalCase, and alpha-digit transitions. Solo 'key' is treated as neutral/non-sensitive.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.description: Token 'author', 'authorName', 'authority' memicu ASTESIA-004 karena implementasi regex substring match /(?:auth)/i bukannya token-based match.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.impact: False Positive pada nama entitas blog/author/authorization authority.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.resolution: Fixed in commit 5ed3666 (Task F-D). Replaced loose substring /(?:auth)/i with discrete token matching. 'author', 'authorName', 'authority' do not match 'auth' token.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.description: Kredensial HTTP 'Basic <base64>' dan 'Bearer <token>' di bawah neutral key (misal 'label', 'description') gagal memicu ASTESIA-004 karena isCandidate mensyaratkan isSensitiveKey(key) || KNOWN_PREFIX.test(val).
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.impact: False Negative (secret leakage) saat kredensial di-assign ke variabel dengan nama non-auth.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.resolution: Fixed in commit 04d77cb (Task F-C). String literals on any line are scanned for Basic and Bearer auth tokens via isAuthBearerOrBasic and trigger ASTESIA-004 regardless of variable name.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.description: Karakter ' # ' di dalam nilai string pada file config (YAML, Dockerfile, .env) memotong baris sebelum '#' sehingga rahasia masuk ke commentLines dan lolos dari scan.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.impact: False Negative (secret leakage) saat password atau token memuat karakter hashtag dengan spasi.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.resolution: Fixed in commit 5314489 (Task F-G). Added quote-tracking preprocessor for YAML and .env files to preserve hash (#) characters inside single and double quotes.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.description: Baris 596 astesia-gate.ts hanya melarang inline suppression untuk ASTESIA-000 dan ASTESIA-004, lupa menyertakan ASTESIA-010 sehingga inline astesia-allow diterima.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.impact: Pelanggaran kontrak F3 (inline allow wajib ditolak untuk 004 dan 010).
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.resolution: Fixed in commit a6bef88 (Task F-H). Added ASTESIA-010 to NEVER_INLINE_SUPPRESS, strictly rejecting inline comments // astesia-allow: ASTESIA-010 with exit 1.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.description: workflow-guard.ts tidak memeriksa keberadaan langkah guard itu sendiri, sehingga PR yang menghapus langkah guard tetap menghasilkan exit code 0.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.impact: Bypass guard via PR jika GitHub Actions ruleset/CODEOWNERS tidak dikonfigurasi ketat.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.resolution: Fixed in commit 73dea5d (Task F-E). Integrated --check-workflow subcommand in astesia-gate.ts validating explicit presence of guard step itself, with fail-closed shell logic in astesia-gate.workflow.yml.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.description: Catastrophic backtracking O(N^2) pada regex assignMatch unanchored di ASTESIA-004 menyebabkan eksekusi 12-15 detik pada baris 100k karakter.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.impact: Denial of Service / CI timeout pada berkas minified atau berkas data bergaris panjang.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.resolution: Fixed in commit 7efd0ff (Task F-A) and 8afd534 (Task F-B). Linearized candidate regex with lookbehind (?<![\w$]) and hasQuote pre-check eliminating ReDoS; batched git calls to max 3 spawns for .env classification.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.description: Regex isAuthBearerOrBasic (/^(?:Basic|Bearer)\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{12,}$/i) tidak menyertakan karakter titik ('.'), sehingga token JWT pada Bearer header gagal dikenali dan lolos sebagai False Negative karena mengandung spasi.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.impact: False Negative pada token autentikasi standar JWT berformat Bearer (misal 'Bearer eyJhbGci...').
templates/enforcement/tests/verify/known.resolution: Fixed in commit 04d77cb (Task F-C). Extended isAuthBearerOrBasic to validate JWT structure (header.payload.signature) including dot ('.') characters and standard base64 Basic credentials.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify2/know.description: astesia-gate.ts baris 203 mengecek lowerName.startsWith('.env'). Saat directory walking melewatkan path absolut (mis. C:\...\.env), kondisi ini false dan extname('.env') adalah empty string '', sehingga berkas .env lolos dari profil config dan jatuh ke tokenizer TS biasa.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify2/know.impact: Komentar # di .env tidak dipotong (memicu FP pada commented secret) dan kutip tak tertutup memicu warning TOKENIZER_DESYNC.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify2/know.resolution: Fixed in commit 8720438 (Task T1 / VER4-001). Implemented profileFor(filePath) using norm.split('/').pop() to ensure basename matching regardless of absolute/relative path or OS separator.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify2/know.description: Token 'pwd' dan 'passphrase' terlewat dari tokenSet check di isSensitiveKey (baris 695), menyebabkan variabel bernama userPwd atau passphrase tidak dikenali sebagai kunci sensitif.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify2/know.impact: False Negative pada rahasia di bawah variabel bernama *pwd atau *passphrase.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify2/know.resolution: Fixed in commit 5fabcd3 (Task T2 / VER4-002). Added 'pwd', 'pwds', 'passphrase', 'passphrases' to hasPassword in isSensitiveKey and to isDirectSecretKey in decision table.

templates/enforcement/tests/verify2/know.description: Token 'auth' sendirian dianggap sensitif di isSensitiveKey, bertentangan dengan kontrak F1 yang menyatakan 'auth sendirian TIDAK sensitif'.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify2/know.impact: False Positive pada variabel bernama 'auth' biasa.
templates/enforcement/tests/verify2/know.resolution: Fixed in commit 5fabcd3 (Task T2 / VER4-003). Explicitly exempted solo 'auth' (tokens.length === 1 && tokens[0] === 'auth' returns false).
